stories.title: US Tennessee’s first execution of a woman in 200 years halted

en.title: US Tennessee's first execution of a woman in 200 years halted
en.summary: A federal appeals court stopped the scheduled execution of death row inmate Christa Pike in Tennessee hours before she was to become the first woman executed in that state in over 200 years. The court granted a temporary stay to consider Pike's claims regarding inadequate consideration of childhood sexual abuse during sentencing.

stories.title: 沃洛金当选连任俄国家杜马主席 普京出席首次全会并讲话

en.title: Volodin re-elected as chairman of Russian State Duma; Putin attends first plenary session and delivers speech
en.summary: Volodin was re-elected as chairman of Russia's State Duma lower house of parliament. President Putin attended the first plenary session of the new Duma and spoke about lawmakers' responsibility to prioritize major state issues and ensure victory.

stories.title: 昆明4.3级地震为正常地震活动

en.title: Kunming 4.3-magnitude earthquake classified as normal seismic activity
en.summary: A 4.3-magnitude earthquake struck Kunming's Panlong District in Yunnan Province on September 30, causing noticeable tremors. Officials determined the quake to be normal earthquake activity.

stories.title: 中网综合：袁悦、布云朝克特迎开门红 德约科维奇首战告捷

en.title: China Open roundup: Yuan Yue and Bukhantsov get off to winning starts; Djokovic triumphs in first match
en.summary: At the 2026 China Open tennis tournament, Chinese player Yuan Yue defeated Olinikova in straight sets. Male player Bukhantsov advanced after a three-set win, while six-time champion Djokovic returned to the event after 11 years and beat Borges in the first round.

stories.title: Taxi passengers take wheel after cabby faints while driving on Hong Kong highway

en.title: Taxi passengers take wheel after cabby faints while driving on Hong Kong highway
en.summary: Four passengers in a Hong Kong taxi took control of the vehicle after their 66-year-old driver lost consciousness on a highway. The taxi struck a road divider before passengers managed to regain control, with dashcam footage documenting the incident.

stories.title: France and Spain welcome idea of UK rejoining EU after Burnham’s speech

en.title: France and Spain welcome idea of UK rejoining EU after Burnham's speech
en.summary: French President Macron and Spanish Prime Minister Sanchez indicated openness to UK re-entry into the European Union following remarks by new UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham suggesting such a possibility.

stories.title: Why did Trump and Xi seal a deal on World War II soldiers’ missing remains?

en.title: Why did Trump and Xi seal a deal on World War II soldiers' missing remains?
en.summary: The US and China have renewed a decades-long effort to recover the remains of American servicemen missing in China since World War II, with this commitment emerging as part of a broader agreement between the two nations' leaders.

stories.title: （爱知·名古屋亚运会）中国跳水队达成亚运“百金”

en.title: (Aichi Nagoya Asian Games) Chinese diving team achieves Asian Games "100 gold medals"
en.summary: China's diving team won its 100th gold medal at the Asian Games when Lian Junjie secured first place in the men's 10-meter platform diving competition on September 30. The Chinese diving team has maintained dominance in the sport since first competing at the Asian Games in 1974.

stories.title: 柬埔寨洪灾影响10省数万户家庭

en.title: Cambodia floods affect tens of thousands of families across 10 provinces
en.summary: Flooding in Cambodia has impacted tens of thousands of households across 10 provinces.

stories.title: Russia sends nuclear warning to Nato over its Kaliningrad enclave

en.title: Russia sends nuclear warning to Nato over its Kaliningrad enclave
en.summary: Russia has warned NATO that it would consider using nuclear weapons if the alliance attempted to isolate Kaliningrad, describing NATO's actions as dangerous and reckless with risks of armed conflict.

stories.title: After the US-China tariff deal, will Chinese factories still need Southeast Asia?

en.title: After the US-China tariff deal, will Chinese factories still need Southeast Asia?
en.summary: A new US-China tariff reduction agreement may reduce incentives for Chinese manufacturers to relocate production to Southeast Asia, potentially shifting the economics of supply chain diversification for many consumer goods.

stories.title: Hong Kong banks set golden week lures for mainland Chinese visitors despite new levies

en.title: Hong Kong banks set golden week lures for mainland Chinese visitors despite new levies
en.summary: Hong Kong banks are offering incentives to attract mainland Chinese visitors during golden week, including cash bonuses and entertainment experiences, following Beijing's new 20 percent levy on overseas investment and insurance gains.

stories.title: New World Development posts HK$26.8b loss after 11 Skies termination

en.title: New World Development posts HK$26.8b loss after 11 Skies termination
en.summary: New World Development reported a HK$26.8 billion net loss for the year ended June, primarily due to HK$18.3 billion in impairments related to the early termination of its 11 Skies mall project.

stories.title: DFI Retail sells stake in Maxim’s in return for Starbucks business, US$340m

en.title: DFI Retail sells stake in Maxim's in return for Starbucks business, US$340m
en.summary: Maxim's Caterers is purchasing DFI Retail's stake for US$340 million and gaining control of the Starbucks licensed business, ending decades of partial ownership by conglomerate Jardine Matheson.

stories.title: Singapore beefs up rivalry with Hong Kong by picking 5 firms to boost equity market

en.title: Singapore beefs up rivalry with Hong Kong by picking 5 firms to boost equity market
en.summary: Singapore's central bank selected five international asset managers to handle S$1.45 billion in locally-focused equity strategies, as part of efforts to strengthen its stock market competitiveness against Hong Kong. The appointment represents the third batch of mandates under the Monetary Authority of Singapore's market development program.

stories.title: Hong Kong’s IPO haul in first 9 months smashes record despite Nasdaq’s fundraising lead

en.title: Hong Kong's IPO haul in first 9 months smashes record despite Nasdaq's fundraising lead
en.summary: Hong Kong IPOs raised US$48.4 billion in the first nine months of 2026, double the previous level and the highest for any comparable period since 1980. A total of 112 companies listed on the main board, with two additional listings on the Growth Enterprise Market.
